Class CourseService

java.lang.Object
project.services.CourseService
public class CourseService extends Object
Handles course browsing, student registration/dropping, and manager approval workflows.

    • studentRegister

      public void studentRegister(Student student, String code)
      Submits a course registration request for a student. Validates fail limit, duplicate enrollment, credit cap, and existing pending requests before creating the request.
      Parameters:
      student - the student requesting enrollment
      code - the course code (e.g. "CS101")

    • addCourse

      public void addCourse(String code, String name, int credits, CourseType courseType, int targetYear, School school)
      Creates and persists a new course. Rejects if the course code already exists.
      Parameters:
      code - unique course code (e.g. "CS201")
      name - full course name
      credits - credit hours
      courseType - MAJOR, MINOR, or FREE_ELECTIVE
      targetYear - the year of study this course targets
      school - the faculty this course belongs to
